item.title: Shuzenji Onsen: Izu's Most Atmospheric Hot Spring Town — Guide
item.description: Shuzenji Onsen, set in a wooded valley in the centre of the Izu Peninsula, is widely considered Izu’s most atmospheric hot spring town, its history beginning with the temple said to have been founded by the monk Kukai some 1,200 years ago. The town wraps around the Katsura River, where vermilion bridges, a riverside footbath at the Tokko-no-yu spring, and a lantern-lit bamboo grove path create a compact, strollable scene of classic Japan, backed by ryokan whose baths draw on the valley’s long-flowing waters.
